title: Audio Folder Unifier - If you collect a bunch of sound that are mismatched, you can unify them under a single style with this
author: Melodic_Charity_1770
selftext:
[Heres another free program](https://reactorcore.itch.io/audio-folder-unifier) I built for my own AI game dev purposes, but since its generally useful for others I polished it into a public release.

Undoubtedly you're gonna need audio or music files for your game and you might collect a bunch of audio asset packs or multiple different music tracks from different artists and different quality standards. If you don't do anything about it, they'll sound mismatched.

I've been dabbling with AI helping me create all kinds of [audio based tools](https://itch.io/c/4651124/programs-and-tools) and this is one more tool that I was still missing from the collection.

It processed the audio files locally using FFMPEG and some libraries to apply curated filters that have been already fine-tuned and tested by me so you won't have to do the hard work of asking your AI agent to try to do it when this program can do it for free, batched and pre-vetted by a hooman (myself).
